name: cosmos-stockdata-tools
description: Fetch and validate daily China A-share and index data with a bundled portable SuperMind runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Fetch and validate daily China stock-market data.
interface.longDescription: Bundles a portable SuperMind notebook, JupyterHub driver, and fail-closed workbook validator for Beijing-time A-share and index extraction. It supports each user's own SuperMind account without external project paths or bundled credentials; akshare and baostock remain future extensions for confirmed coverage gaps.
defaultPrompt: Fetch and validate the latest completed Beijing trading day's full A-share dataset.
Download an existing SuperMind workbook for a specified trading date.
Check whether SuperMind can provide a new stock-data field.
